# Eason Wu Apps

> Independent iOS apps by Eason Wu. Each app has a page in Traditional Chinese and English, plus pages in the other languages its App Store listing ships in; facts come from the live App Store text.
Questions and answers in Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German: https://agentmesh.uk/llms-full.txt


## Inside: Phone Check / 機況 Inside－手機健檢
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/inside/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816782363?pt=102436810&ct=llms_inside&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/inside/support.html
- A warm, clear look at your whole phone: checks, hardware, battery, performance, charging.
- 用溫暖、清楚的方式看看手機現在的狀態；從功能、硬體、電池到效能，一次全面檢查。
- Q: Is there a free app that checks an iPhone's screen, cameras, speakers and microphones in one go? A: Yes. Inside offers a free step-by-step check and a 2-minute quick check covering display and touch, every camera, speakers, each microphone, Face ID or Touch ID, sensors, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and charging, and saves a shareable report.
- Q: How can I tell whether my iPhone is charging slowly or fast? A: Open Inside's charging clock while charging: it shows slow, standard or fast charging, roughly how many watts, and the time to 80%. History compares the curves of different chargers. These features are free.
- Q: How do I see my iPhone's battery health and cycle count? A: Battery health is in Settings › Battery. Inside can import the iPhone's Analytics diagnostics to read the cycle count and adds it to the check report; Inside Pro adds a battery health trend.
- Q: Is Inside free? A: The basic check, charging clock and reports are free. Inside Pro (monthly, yearly with a free first week, or lifetime) adds watermark-free PDF reports, battery health trends and advanced tools.
- Q: My iPhone speaker sounds quiet or the microphone is muffled. How can I check it myself? A: Inside's step-by-step check tests the speakers and each microphone with four test tones, points out the weak bands and checks left and right channels; results go into a report you can compare with the last round. It records this run and your judgement only, not a repair diagnosis.
- Q: Part of my iPhone's touchscreen seems unresponsive. How can I test it? A: Inside's step-by-step check covers the display, touch and multi-touch, which you operate and record yourself; the 2-minute check also runs through the screen and touch. The basic check is free.
- Q: My iPhone storage is full. How do I find photos I can delete? A: Inside's free-up-space tool finds duplicate, similar, blurry and burst photos, screenshots and large videos, suggests which one to keep and deletes only what you confirm; the free version scans the latest 300 photos.
- 简体中文: 机况 Inside－手机检测 https://agentmesh.uk/inside/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Inside: スマホチェック https://agentmesh.uk/inside/ja/
- 한국어: Inside: 휴대폰 점검 https://agentmesh.uk/inside/ko/
- Español: Inside: Revisa tu celular https://agentmesh.uk/inside/es/
- Français: Inside: Test du téléphone https://agentmesh.uk/inside/fr/
- Deutsch: Inside: Handy-Check https://agentmesh.uk/inside/de/

## Daikon: Period Tracker / 蘿蔔日記 Daikon－經期紀錄
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822485511?pt=102436810&ct=llms_daikon&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/support.html
- A little care, every day.
- 每天一點，溫柔照顧。
- Q: Is there a simple, cute period tracker app? A: Daikon shows your period, predicted fertile window and ovulation on a cycle ring, logs a period with one tap, and keeps you company with little radish characters.
- Q: Can a period tracker also be a diary? A: Yes. Daikon has a page per day for mood, body notes, text, handwriting, up to nine photos and voice memos, and spots symptoms that recur at the same point in your cycle.
- Q: Can I export Daikon records for my doctor? A: Cycle records export as PDF, past records import from CSV or Apple Health, and the app can be locked with Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode.
- Q: Does a period tracker like Daikon upload my data? A: Daikon needs no account and has no social features or subscription. Records and journal entries, including photos and voice memos, stay on the device and sync only through your private iCloud when available. Health data is never sent to ad SDKs or used for advertising.
- Q: Can a period log sync with Apple Health? A: Yes. Turn on Sync to Apple Health in Daikon's settings and each period day is written to the Health app as menstrual flow; it is off by default. Past periods can also be imported from Health or a CSV file.
- Q: If I forget to log my period, does the prediction keep going? A: Yes. Daikon uses up to your last six cycles or a length you set; without a new entry the prediction keeps rolling forward and gently reminds you to log. Predictions are for reference only, not medical advice, and not for contraception.
- 简体中文: 萝卜日记 Daikon－经期记录 https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Daikon: 生理と周期の記録 https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/ja/
- 한국어: Daikon: 생리 주기 기록 https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/ko/
- Español: Daikon: Calendario menstrual https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/es/
- Français: Daikon: Suivi des règles https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/fr/
- Deutsch: Daikon: Periodenkalender https://agentmesh.uk/daikon/de/

## Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer / 收好 Tuck－AI 截圖整理
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6821961896?pt=102436810&ct=llms_tuck&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/support.html
- Screenshots piling up? Tuck's AI reads every screenshot and file you save: bookings, receipts and warranties, and the restaurants, recipes and things to buy you screenshot. It files each one and finds it again from a few words. Reading happens on your device, with Apple Intelligence where available; Advanced reading by Claude is optional.
- 截圖越存越多、要用時找不到？收好的 AI 會讀懂你存下的每張截圖與檔案：訂位、收據、保固，還有截下來的餐廳、食譜和想買的東西。自動分好類，之後搜幾個字就找回。辨識在手機上完成，支援 Apple Intelligence；也可以選用 Claude 高階辨識。
- Q: What app organizes the screenshots piling up on my iPhone? A: Tuck reads screenshots and files on the device with AI, recognises bookings, tickets, receipts, warranties and documents, files them automatically, and finds them again from a few words.
- Q: How do I keep receipts organised on an iPhone? A: Save receipt photos or screenshots in Tuck: receipts are grouped by month with totals, and a month of receipts exports as CSV and PDF for expenses.
- Q: Is there an app that reminds me of warranty and return deadlines? A: Tuck finds expiry, renewal and return deadlines in what you save and suggests reminders; warranties show their end date and remind you a month before.
- Q: Does Tuck upload my screenshots? A: Recognition runs on the iPhone by default, with Apple Intelligence support; content is sent out only when you choose the optional Claude advanced reading for it.
- Q: Does Tuck need an account or a subscription? A: No sign-in is needed. Tuck is free with ads, and a one-time purchase removes them. Advanced recognition is free once a day; the optional Tuck Pro and Tuck Max subscriptions add more uses and no ads.
- Q: How can I keep flight, hotel and booking screenshots for a trip together? A: Save them to Tuck and the trip folder lists flights, stays and booking codes by date, and reminds you before a document expires; bookings and tickets can also be added to Calendar.
- 简体中文: 收好 Tuck－AI 截图整理 https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Tuck: AIスクショ整理とレシート https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/ja/
- 한국어: Tuck: 영수증 보관함 https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/ko/
- Español: Tuck: Guarda tus recibos https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/es/
- Français: Tuck: Gardez vos reçus https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/fr/
- Deutsch: Tuck: Belege aufbewahren https://agentmesh.uk/tuck/de/

## ZaiRi: Plant Watering Reminder / 栽日 ZaiRi－植物澆水提醒
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816606160?pt=102436810&ct=llms_zairi&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/support.html
- Give every plant day a place to grow.
- 把植物的每一天，好好留住。
- Q: Is there a plant app that reminds me to water? A: ZaiRi schedules watering, feeding and repotting for each plant with notifications, and a Home Screen widget lists today's care.
- Q: How do I keep a record of my plants' growth? A: Take growth photos and notes in ZaiRi, then turn them into a time-lapse or before-and-after view; data stays on your iPhone with no account.
- Q: Does ZaiRi cost anything? A: Every plant-journal feature is free with occasional full-screen ads; a one-time purchase removes ads.
- Q: Is there a plant journal app that identifies plants from photos? A: ZaiRi can identify a plant from a photo and keeps growth photos, care logs and custom fields, plus growth time-lapses and before-and-after images. All plant journal features are free.
- Q: How can I tell if a spot has enough light for a plant? A: ZaiRi has a camera light meter you can use where the plant sits, and lets you browse and manage plants by location.
- Q: Does ZaiRi need an account, and where is my data stored? A: No account or server is needed. Data and photos stay on your iPhone, and you can export and restore a full backup yourself.
- 简体中文: 栽日 ZaiRi－植物浇水提醒 https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: ZaiRi: 植物の水やり管理 https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/ja/
- 한국어: ZaiRi: 식물 물주기 알리미 https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/ko/
- Español: ZaiRi: Recordatorio de riego https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/es/
- Français: ZaiRi: Rappel d’arrosage https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/fr/
- Deutsch: ZaiRi: Pflanzen gießen https://agentmesh.uk/zairi/de/

## Roomory: Floor Plans / 居圖 Roomory－平面圖
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6825348801?pt=102436810&ct=llms_roomory&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/support.html
- From moving a sofa to planning a renovation, Roomory helps you turn the space you have into the layout you want. Scan a room or start by hand, then edit your floor plans and preview your ideas in 3D.
- 從重新擺放家具，到準備整戶裝潢，居圖陪你把現有的空間，整理成心中的配置。掃描房間或手動開始，在平面圖上調整，再用 3D 預覽看看想法。
- Q: Which app scans a room with an iPhone to make a floor plan? A: Roomory scans rooms with a LiDAR iPhone or iPad, capturing walls, doors, windows and furniture into an editable floor plan with a 3D preview; devices without LiDAR can draw plans by hand.
- Q: How can I try a furniture layout on my phone before moving things? A: In Roomory, adjust furniture size, position and angle on the plan, switch to 3D to see layout, materials and daylight, and save design versions to compare.
- Q: Is Roomory free? A: Scanning, modelling, plan editing, multiple projects, backups, iCloud sync and basic 3D furniture are free with ads. Roomory Pro (monthly or yearly) adds PDF, DXF, SVG and USDZ export, all furniture and materials, the AI assistant and no ads.
- Q: Can I draw a floor plan on an iPhone without LiDAR? A: Yes. Roomory lets you create and edit floor plans by hand on devices without LiDAR, including multi-room and multi-floor projects; only room scanning needs an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR.
- Q: How can I show my renovation layout to a designer or contractor? A: In Roomory you adjust building, furniture and fixture layers, then switch to 3D to try materials and daylight; Roomory Pro exports A3 PDF sets, editable DXF and 3D models.
- Q: Are room scan measurements accurate enough to build from? A: Roomory's scanned dimensions should be re-measured on site, and drawings still need review by a qualified professional before work starts; Roomory does not provide professional sign-off.
- 简体中文: 居图 Roomory－平面图 https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Roomory: 間取りと3D https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/ja/
- 한국어: Roomory: 우리 집 도면 https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/ko/
- Español: Roomory: Planos de casa https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/es/
- Français: Roomory: Plans de maison https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/fr/
- Deutsch: Roomory: Räume planen https://agentmesh.uk/roomory/de/

## Nightvane: Star Guide / 尋星 Nightvane－星空導覽
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826494660?pt=102436810&ct=llms_starplace&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/support.html
- Hold your iPhone or iPad up to the night and Nightvane shows what you are looking at: stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way, right where they are.
- 舉起 iPhone 或 iPad 對著夜空，尋星就告訴你眼前是什麼：恆星、行星、星座、月亮與銀河，都在它們真正的位置上。
- Q: Which app identifies stars when I point my iPhone at the sky? A: Point an iPhone or iPad at the sky in Nightvane and it labels stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way in place. It is free.
- Q: What can I see in the sky tonight? A: Nightvane's Tonight list shows what is worth seeing from your location with times and directions, including meteor showers, ISS passes, Moon phases and eclipses.
- Q: How do I find a meteor shower's radiant? A: Search for the shower in Nightvane; arrows and gentle haptics guide you to the radiant and show when it rises tonight.
- Q: How do I know when the International Space Station passes over me? A: Nightvane's Tonight list shows visible passes of the International Space Station and Tiangong for your location, along with objects worth seeing and where to look.
- Q: My phone is too bright for stargazing. What can I do? A: Nightvane has a red night-vision mode that keeps your dark adaptation; if the compass is off, aim at the Moon or a bright star once to calibrate.
- Q: Is Nightvane free? A: Yes, with ads; a one-time purchase removes them. There is no subscription and no account.
- 简体中文: 寻星 Nightvane－星空导览 https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Nightvane: 星さがし https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/ja/
- 한국어: Nightvane: 별 찾기 https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/ko/
- Español: Nightvane: Ver las estrellas https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/es/
- Français: Nightvane: Guide des étoiles https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/fr/
- Deutsch: Nightvane: Sternenführer https://agentmesh.uk/starplace/de/

## Lockwater: Canal Puzzle / 水閘 Lockwater－運河解謎
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6826767889?pt=102436810&ct=llms_lockwater&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/support.html
- Lockwater is a canal puzzle made of soft clay: a row of stone chambers, a few wooden gates, and boats that must reach the flag of their color.
- 《水閘》是一款黏土質感的運河解謎：一排石砌閘室、幾道木閘門，還有要回到同色旗子旁的小船。
- Q: Is there a calm puzzle game that makes you think? A: Lockwater is a clay-style canal puzzle where every opened gate levels the water for good, so the order is the puzzle; over 100 levels, free to play.
- Q: How do you play Lockwater? A: Tap a gate and the water on both sides settles at one level; tap a boat and it sails through the open gates to its flag. Water never comes back, so the order you open the gates in is the whole puzzle. A solver checks every level, and a level ends at once when the canal can no longer be won.
- Q: Is Lockwater free? A: Yes. A banner and an occasional ad between levels keep it free; a one-time purchase removes them. Hint packs are also available.
- 简体中文: 水闸 Lockwater－运河解谜 https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Lockwater: 運河パズル https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/ja/
- 한국어: Lockwater: 운하 퍼즐 https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/ko/
- Español: Lockwater: Acertijo de canales https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/es/
- Français: Lockwater : Puzzle d'écluses https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/fr/
- Deutsch: Lockwater: Schleusen-Rätsel https://agentmesh.uk/lockwater/de/

## Prawnlight: Prawn Hall Tycoon / 夜釣蝦場 Prawnlight－釣蝦場大亨
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6828219014?pt=102436810&ct=llms_prawnlight&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/support.html
- Prawnlight is a management game set in a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall that stays open late into the night. You are the boss, not the angler: order stock, release prawns, lay out the floor, hire staff and keep the guests fishing until closing time.
- 夜釣蝦場是一款台灣室內釣蝦場的經營遊戲。你是老闆，不用自己下竿：叫貨、放蝦、擺設場地、請人顧店，讓客人一路釣到深夜。
- Q: Is there a game about running a Taiwanese prawn-fishing hall? A: Prawnlight puts you in charge of an indoor prawn-fishing hall in Taiwan: choose a site, stock prawns, lay out the hall, hire staff and run contests while paying off a loan. Free to play.
- Q: Is Prawnlight free? A: Yes. Ads play only when you choose to watch one for a reward; optional in-app purchases are available.
- Q: What do you do in Prawnlight? A: You run a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall: pick a site on the map of Taiwan, place pools and grills, hire staff, hold contests and hourly prawn releases, then expand or open branches. You start with a loan, so growing too fast runs you out of cash.
- 简体中文: 夜釣蝦場 Prawnlight－釣蝦場大亨 https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Prawnlight: エビ釣り堀経営 https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/ja/
- 한국어: Prawnlight: 새우낚시터 타이쿤 https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/ko/
- Español: Prawnlight: Rey del camarón https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/es/
- Français: Prawnlight : Roi des crevettes https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/fr/
- Deutsch: Prawnlight: Garnelen-Tycoon https://agentmesh.uk/prawnlight/de/

## Precision Parking 3D / 極限停車場：都市挑戰
- Page: https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6816430472?pt=102436810&ct=llms_precisionparking3d&mt=8
- Support and FAQ: https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/support.html
- Slow down. Find your angle. Make every space count.
- 在都市停車場裡，慢一點，停得更漂亮。
- Q: Is there a phone game for practising parking? A: Precision Parking 3D has three tutorial levels and 40 levels in five chapters to practise steering, pedals and gears, playable offline.
- Q: Can Precision Parking 3D be played offline? A: All core levels work offline, and progress and achievements stay on your device; advertising and privacy services need a connection.
- Q: Is there a parking game with a steering wheel control? A: Precision Parking 3D lets you choose left/right buttons, sliding steering or a rotating wheel, and switch between third-person and overhead views; each level has three objectives: park, avoid collisions and an extra challenge.
- 简体中文: 极限停车场：都市挑战 https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/zh-Hans/
- 日本語: Precision Parking 3D https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/ja/
- 한국어: Precision Parking 3D https://agentmesh.uk/precision-parking-3d/ko/
